description: This file defines a React component for the Reset Password page in an e-commerce web application. It connects to Redux for state management and handles user interactions for resetting passwords, including redirecting authenticated users.

classes.name: ResetPassword
classes.description: A React component for the Reset Password page, managing form submission and redirecting authenticated users.

methods.name: handleResetPassword
methods.description: Handles the reset password action by extracting the token from URL parameters and dispatching the resetPassword action.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the reset password form or redirects if the user is already authenticated.
